reason: I only pay cash when the thing is in my hand. You want the item price and your fee before anything ships, from a new page I've never heard of, and then I wait 2 to 3 weeks hoping it comes.
objection: Paying up front to a new service. If the item is wrong, fake or never arrives, how do I get my money back? And if I just don't like it I can't return it at all.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me pay everything cash on delivery, or a friend or relative telling me they ordered from you several times and got their stuff fine.
